svg.title: Voronoi nested control architecture
svg.desc: Four coupled planes. A deterministic control plane (dispatcher) admits work and wakes an episodic reasoning plane (orchestrator running OODA), which spawns a disposable execution plane of parallel hypothesis tranches. All hand-offs are durable writes into an append-only evidence plane of git, Beads and .swarm state. A science plane applies a progressive rigor ladder, validity audits, a judgment tribunal and a convergence gate before any deliverable is emitted.
svg.text: VORONOI · NESTED CONTROL ARCHITECTURE FOR AUTONOMOUS SCIENCE
A deterministic control plane, an episodic reasoning plane, a disposable execution plane and an append-only evidence plane — coupled only through durable state.
durable · append-only · the sole inter-agent channel
one entry contract for every path: free text + repository → Investigation
makes no scientific judgment — never selects a hypothesis, never evaluates a finding
owns all scientific judgment — never sleeps, merges, or enters a worktree
one git worktree + tmux window per worker · read-only roles get --deny-tool=write
every gate reads from the evidence plane; none of them writes results
poll 10 s · progress digest 30 s · throttled to 5 min while the orchestrator is parked
session boundary — state travels in the checkpoint, not in context; every cycle starts fresh

g.text: own branch, worktree and tmux window
refilled the moment an arm closes
agent cap scales with accrued evidence

svg.text: INNER LOOP — every worker verifies itself before it closes a task
ROLE LIBRARY (19 definitions in voronoi/data/agents/) — question-framer · assumption-auditor · scout · investigator · explorer · statistician · critic · theorist
methodologist · synthesizer · evaluator · scribe · red-team · outliner · lit-synthesizer · figure-critic · refiner · worker-agent · swarm-orchestrator

g.text: written by agents, read by every plane, archived per run
every LLM call recorded with its inputs

svg.text: Every hand-off is a durable write that
survives a crash, restart or new run.
rigor is chosen at intake; DISCOVER escalates itself as hypotheses harden
D DISCOVER initial · D+ DISCOVER escalated · S PROVE scientific · E PROVE experimental

g.text: EVA — three mandatory checks on every experiment,
Anti-fabrication — no synthetic or simulated results

svg.text: DESIGN_INVALID never fails silently — it escalates and forces a re-design
a surprising result is not a finding until the tribunal can account for it

g.text: evaluator CCSAN score ≥ threshold · zero open blockers

svg.text: /voronoi continue → additive next run, warm-started from claims
every claim → linked finding → hashed artifact
ADMIT · the dispatcher takes ownership of the investigation
SPAWN · one fresh git worktree and tmux window per worker

Coupling rule — every hand-off between planes is a durable write to the evidence plane; no agent addresses another directly. Control never reasons about science, reasoning never manages processes, and execution never persists anything outside git, Beads and .swarm/.
